[[Westmeath GAA|Westmeath]] and [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] entered Division 1 as the promoted teams. On 3 May 1987, [[Galway GAA|Galway]] won the title following a 3–12 to 3–10 win over [[Clare GAA|Clare]] in the final. It was their first league title since [[1974-75 National Hurling League|1974-75]] and their 3rd National League title overall.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] and Westmeath were relegated from Division 1.
